thor-api.notes: proto/ generates each side of the Thor.Api <-> intelligence-engine gRPC contract at build time (Grpc.Tools here, scripts/generate_grpc.py there), so a contract-only change has to rebuild both or the two sides silently drift apart.

intelligence-engine.notes: No backend/shared/** - that is .NET-only code this Python service never builds against.

workflow-ingestion.notes: One image serves every step of the workflow, and the whole backend/workflows/ tree goes into it - platform/ as much as ingestion/ - so there is nothing finer to filter on.

workflow-atre.notes: Same filter as workflow-ingestion, and deliberately not narrowed to backend/workflows/atre/**: both images are built from the same Dockerfile over the same context and both carry platform/ and shared/, so a change to either rebuilds both. Narrowing this would let a platform change ship to one workflow and not the other.

workflow-ownership.notes: Same filter as workflow-ingestion and workflow-atre, for workflow-atre's reason: every workflow image is built from the same Dockerfile over the same context, so a platform/ or shared/ change must rebuild all of them.

workflow-graph-load.notes: Same filter as the other workflow images, for workflow-atre's reason.

workflow-pai.notes: Same filter as the other workflow images, for workflow-atre's reason.

workflow-reconcile.notes: Same filter as the other workflow images, for workflow-atre's reason.
